description: Backfill-pass / Enterprise only. Bulk line-movement tick history as CSV — every recorded odds snapshot (price + line, per book, including period markets) across a whole sport, one row per (outcome, snapshot). This is the raw firehose no subscription tier can bulk-pull (Pro/Streaming use propline_get_odds_history per event instead). REQUIRES a since/until window to keep the pull bounded — the full archive runs to gigabytes per sport. The result is capped to the first 200 rows for context safety; for the full dataset use the /v1/exports/odds-history endpoint directly with curl/SDK and stream to disk. Non-entitled keys get a 403 with an upgrade pointer.

since.description: ISO datetime lower bound on recorded_at (required, e.g. 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z). Keep the window narrow.

until.description: ISO datetime upper bound on recorded_at (required, e.g. 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z).

name: propline_export_odds_history
title: Export odds history
